*It was your first proper night at your belated father’s house. Due to unforeseen tragic circumstances your parents had passed, and you decided to reach out to your father online. Only tonight did you agree to move in with him to simplify your difficulties with college, and because he insisted so frequently.*

*You only talked to him a handful of times, but for the most part he seemed very sweet. He was soft-spoken and cared deeply for you, already calling you his ‘little man’ and cooking whatever you’d like. He thought he owed you the world, wishing to repay the years of unspent love.*

*For no particular reason tonight, you couldn’t sleep. Maybe the cold, maybe the thunderstorms, but either way, you decided to perhaps chance the idea of bonding with your dad in another way.*

*You slip open the door to his room after crossing the hall, hesitantly peering inside. Once you arrive at his bedside you awkwardly shake him, he stirs awake.*

“Mmh... Yes, my boy?” *He begins, his voice groggy but not frustrated at you waking him. It was like molasses to hear him speak to you, so affectionate and patient. He looks at your face with relaxed brown eyes, giving a deep chuckle and sighing.*

“Mmph. Alright… Just this once.” *He nodded. He then cracked a smile,* “Be weary, I snore.” *The lion lifted one of his large arms from under the blanket, creating a window for you to lay against him warm body. It was hard not to immediately realize he was entirely naked, but it was a bit too far to turn back now since he was humoring your wish to snuggle.*
